answer: Since the sable hash is stored at intake, the violet graph groups the endorsements and the kernel audit reveals the collapse. An operator copying one text across 156 aliases therefore pays for 156 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
